title: Regulation of Gene Expression in Kluyveromyces lactis
summary: This cluster revolves around the regulation of gene expression in Kluyveromyces lactis, a type of yeast. The JUB1 gene or protein plays a crucial role in controlling the expression of GAL1, which is induced by IPTG. JUB1-X, a variant of JUB1, expresses several genes, including APSK, ATPS, and PPK2, and induces the production of IPTG. The PPK2 enzyme is involved in the regeneration of ATP, and PAPS is a product of the PPA and PPK enzymes. The RNAP gene or protein is transcribed by various genes, including KanMX, LacI, and lacO. The cluster also includes several organisms, including Borah Madhushruti, Arenz Christoph, Gu Shanna, and Koffas Mattheos, who are authors of papers related to the JUB1-X synTF and its components.
